title: JJK – Central 47 Database Terminal
description: Jujutsu Sorcery Commission classified network terminal. Opens from the Journal sidebar — available to all players and the GM for in-session roleplay access.
description-changes: v3.0.1 — Distributed Synchronisation Layer (RFC-003). The forum is now a shared persistent world object: posts, replies, and votes replicate to every connected client in real time over the Foundry socket, and an authoritative Forum State journal (created automatically by the GM's client, owned by all players) persists the board so a terminal opened fresh — or days later — hydrates with everything anyone has ever posted. Deletions propagate as tombstones and never resurrect.
